### 1. Load Packages
```{r}
library(ggdag)
library(ggplot2)
```

### 2. SPHC 2002
#### 2.1. m-DAG
```{r}
theme_set( theme_dag() + theme( strip.text = element_blank() ) )

coords <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ name,                          ~ x,      ~ y,
  "country_of_birth",              0,        -0.50,
  "sexual_identity_t1",            0.25,     0,
  "income",                        0.50,     -0.50,
  "self_report_outcome",           1.00,     -0.50,
  "loss_to_follow_up",             1.25,     0,
  "sexual_identity_t2",            1.50,     -0.50
  )

set.seed( 123 )
missing_dag <- dagify(
  
  self_report_outcome ~ sexual_identity_t1 + income,
  income ~ sexual_identity_t1 + country_of_birth,
  loss_to_follow_up ~ self_report_outcome + income + country_of_birth + sexual_identity_t1,
  sexual_identity_t2 ~ sexual_identity_t1,

  exposure = "sexual_identity_t2",
  outcome = "loss_to_follow_up",
  latent = "sexual_identity_t1",
  
  labels = c(
    "sexual_identity_t1" = "Sexual identity\nin 2002",
    "self_report_outcome" = "Self-reported\nmental health",
    "income" = "Income",
    "loss_to_follow_up" = "Loss to\nfollow-up",
    "country_of_birth" = "Country of birth",
    "sexual_identity_t2" = "Sexual identity\nin 2010"
    ),
  
  coords = coords
  
  )

missing_dag <- ggdag( missing_dag, 
             text = FALSE, 
             use_labels = "label"
             )
missing_dag
ggsave( "missing_dag_2002.svg", plot = missing_dag, width = 9.5, height = 4 )

```
